summary.intent: Complete phase 19.1 execution by running the remaining plans (05-06) of the SDK extraction, after a security review was interrupted in favor of continuing execution.
summary.outcome: Plan 05 (Rewire Web App Hooks to SDK) was marked complete by creating its SUMMARY.md — the implementation was already done across 14 commits in a prior session. Phase execution resumed from wave 4 with plan 06 still pending.

repo: Phase 19.1 is 'Extract Core Crypto SDK as Shared Package' — rewiring React hooks/Zustand stores to use CipherBoxClient instead of direct service calls
The project uses a GSD (Get Shit Done) workflow system with wave-based parallel plan execution, STATE.md tracking, and SUMMARY.md completion markers
Plan 05 involved 14 commits: SDK provider, folder mutations, upload/download rewiring, bin hooks, and multiple bug fixes including dual-path IPNS and bin loadBin empty state
Integration tests cover full lifecycle (folder CRUD, upload, download, rename, delete) and bin lifecycle (loadBin on fresh account, deleteToBin, verify entries, reload from IPNS)

Code review fixes addressed: btoa stack overflow, axios instance caching, saveBinMetadata parameter sprawl, BinNotLoadedError class, Uint8Array.buffer fix, dynamic imports hoisting, orphaned CID cleanup, no-op ensureFolderRegistered removal, _sdkUnsubscribe moved to module-level
workflow: GSD plans with has_summary:true are skipped on resume — SUMMARY.md is the completion marker, not commit presence
When a plan is fully implemented but lacks a SUMMARY.md, the executor should verify artifacts exist then create the summary rather than re-executing
Integration tests should be run against the actual dev server, not mocked — the user explicitly called this out as required behavior
Security review (/security:review) can be scoped to 'the implementation given a prior review doc' — useful for post-implementation validation against pre-implementation findings

friction: Plan 05 was partially executed in a previous session without a SUMMARY.md being created, causing the orchestrator to re-enter the plan rather than skip it cleanly
Security review agent was interrupted mid-spawn when the user switched to execute-phase instead
Integration tests were initially skipped — required explicit user correction to run them against the dev server
